purpose: the preflight contract the Colab notebook checks before it builds or trains anything. Counts and hashes here were derived locally at the commit named below; a mismatch in Colab means the inputs are not the audited ones and the run must stop.
sealed_test_note: EyeCU sealed TEST is deliberately absent from this manifest. Nothing here names it, and no path below can reach it.

arm_definitions.A00: EyeCU TRAIN labels + source-TRAIN observed labels after semantic class remap. The source ball state is MIXED -- this is NOT ACTIVE_ONLY and NOT ALL_VISIBLE-clean.
arm_definitions.shared: identical 1,030 training image ids in all three arms; labels are the only difference
arm_definitions.deletions: none. EXISTING_NON_ACTIVE_BALL_GT is provenance, never a deletion instruction.

remap_rule: resolve by category NAME and assert the four names before conversion. The two schemas reuse the same integers for different classes, so an id-based merge silently relabels every box.

experiments/external_sources/keremberke_.role: human ball-role ledger; the latest row per missing_object_id is effective
the seeded Round-0 draw; its train slice is the 207
governing design; the builder asserts against it

inputs_from_drive.note: none of these are in git. Images and weights are gitignored; the repaired export is untracked. They must be staged under DRIVE_INPUT_ROOT at the relative paths given here.

EyeCU_external_data/huggingface/kerember.note: only the 207 Round-0 train images are read. Staging the whole train/ directory is fine; staging valid/ or test/ is not required and they are never read.

tree_sha256_rule: sha256 over sorted(basename + sha256(content)) for every file in the directory. Implemented as sha256_tree in tools/build_stage_a_dataset.py.

holdouts.status: PRESERVED -- excluded from Stage-A training and from Stage-A validation
holdouts.eyecu_sealed_test: SEALED -- not read, not staged, not evaluated

validation.set: existing EyeCU val split, 208 images, unaltered, shared by all three arms
validation.limitation: the current validation does NOT directly measure the A10->A11 multi-ball increment. It has 0 multi-ball frames, so a correctly detected extra football scores as a false positive. Ball AP/precision must not be the primary A10->A11 decision metric. This limitation is carried forward, not solved here.

training.initialization: official COCO-pretrained yolo26s.pt, the same file for all three arms
training.arm_independence: yolo26s.pt -> A00, yolo26s.pt -> A10, yolo26s.pt -> A11. Never chained.
forbidden: batch=-1 or any automatic batch sizing
initializing any arm from best_A_960.pt, best_C_960.pt or eyecu_football_v1.pt
training.oom_policy: if batch=3 OOMs, stop that arm and report. Do not reduce batch to make it fit.

readout.rule: best.pt selects on fitness=mAP50-95 over a VAL whose ball semantics penalise exactly the A11 intervention, so it must not replace the final-epoch result.

environment.why: the accumulate=21, lr_fit=0.00125 and effective-weight-decay arithmetic in the design were verified against 8.4.116 trainer.py. A different minor version can change them.
environment.torch: use the CUDA build Colab ships; record the version, do not replace it with a pinned CPU wheel

audit_provenance_note: Hashes were computed on the working tree at local commit 7249660f6bb765e74b2694945f1f3c266b9ed609, which is one commit ahead of 77af420b053fa9ab6189257198ca8a896f499901 and was never pushed.
